narrative.overview: PF Health feels like a carefully organized personal record: warm, legible, and operational rather than official or bureaucratic. The interface reveals one result, one issue, its owner, and its evidence in that order.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces with deep-blue file geometry.
Stable before-and-after layouts for direct 4/5 to 5/5 comparison.
Plain-language status paired with authored outline icons and text.
Progressive evidence disclosure and one primary decision per state.

rules.name: Evidence Before Accent
rules.body: Color guides attention, but source-backed language establishes meaning.

rules.name: Status Has Two Signals
rules.body: Never communicate health, attention, or review state by color alone.

rules.name: Plain Language First
rules.body: Explain the record in everyday language before introducing rule identifiers or evidence metadata.

rules.name: One Active Decision
rules.body: Each screen or action region presents one unmistakable primary action.

rules.name: Flat Record
rules.body: Shadows are not used for persistent content; structure comes from borders, layers, and silhouette.

dos: Do preserve the same five-row information architecture before and after revalidation.
Do pair every status color with text and an authored icon.
Do keep evidence, limitations, and synthetic/non-affiliation disclosure visible in the journey.
donts: Don't imitate an EPFO or government portal or imply official affiliation.
Don't add dashboard density, chatbot bubbles, decorative charts, gradients, shadows, or celebratory gamification.
Don't replace the solid file-to-dossier bridge with a dashed connector.
